item.title: Iranians Seek Respite in Nature Amid the War
item.summary: Families gathered for picnics and games this week to mark the end of the Iranian new year holiday, seizing on a brief chance to celebrate.

item.title: Iran War Live Updates: U.S. Searches for Missing Airman as Israel Launches Fresh Strikes on Tehran
item.summary: Iran downed an F-15E, the first U.S. warplane the country has shot down in the war. In southwest Iran, one person was killed when a projectile struck the perimeter of a nuclear power plant, Iranian media reported.

item.title: Europe’s Options in the Strait of Hormuz: Few, and Risky
item.summary: European leaders and other officials have ideas for bringing shipping back to the strait once the Iran war ends. But none of them are sure bets.

item.title: What We Know About the F-15E Strike Eagle Shot Down by Iran
item.summary: An F-15E Strike Eagle was lost to enemy fire and an A-10 Warthog crashed in the Persian Gulf region on Friday, officials said. A rescue helicopter was also fired upon.

item.title: Ex-US Army Pilot Recalls Battle for Survival When Shot Down in Iraq
item.summary: Ronald Young Jr. was in the Army when his Apache Longbow copter went down during the U.S. invasion of Iraq.

item.title: Rima Hassan Is Charged With Glorifying Terrorism Online in Social Media Post
item.summary: Rima Hassan, a member of the European Parliament, could face seven years in prison for the post, in which she quoted a perpetrator of a 1972 massacre in Israel.

item.title: Myanmar Junta Chief Ascends to President, Five Years After Coup
item.summary: U Min Aung Hlaing’s elevation to the civilian post is the conclusion of elections in the country, which were stage managed by the military.

item.title: Trump Pledged a Quick End to the Iran War, but He Hasn’t Explained How
item.summary: President Trump bet that American firepower could cow Iran into compliance. So far, Iran’s leaders have been unwilling to quit.

item.title: ‘Iran Is Being Destroyed in Front of Our Eyes’: Tehran Is Gripped by Fear
item.summary: Fifteen residents of Tehran said in telephone interviews and text messages that the capital was weathering heavy bombardment Friday.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Friday
item.summary: An American fighter jet was shot down by Iran for the first time since the start of the war, leading to an urgent search-and-rescue operation for a missing crew member.
